info.title: software-factory API
info.description: Generated by scripts/gen-api.mjs from the declarations in src/api/index.ts. Do not edit: run `npm run gen:api`.

get.summary: Every autonomous actor with its name, what it does now, its last and next run and its recent actions (outcome, reason, transcript or log link; none older than the retention days), and the open factory alerts (clear one with POST /api/v1/alarms/dismiss).

post.summary: Send the owner's message to the chat and run one turn with the Ask model; no session_id starts a new session. A withheld turn answers no reply.

get.summary: One chat session's stored messages in order (?session_id=<id>); an unknown session answers none.
The recent chat turns, newest first, at most limit (default 50): each with its turn_id, session_id, status, reason and times.
The work items, ranked, with the list's facets and counts; filtered by state, stage, tier, run kind, unblocks, closed, words (q) and task project.

post.summary: Store a new schedule; run_now true stores it due now.
Remove the schedule and its suggestions; answers it as it was.
Draft a schedule from words with the Ask model; stores nothing.
Change only the fields given; null clears a USD cap.
Propose a better text for a schedule with the Ask model; stores nothing.

get.summary: Every schedule, Check a page ones too, as stored, with skip_when_busy.

post.summary: Pause a schedule: none of its slots fire.
Resume a paused schedule at its first slot after now.
Make the schedule due now, so the next tick fires it once.

get.summary: One schedule's suggestions, oldest first, each state as of now (?schedule=<id>).
